$comment: Reviewed findings from tools/validate-shared-component-claims.mjs. Every entry needs a written reason of at least 40 characters, and an entry whose finding no longer fires must be deleted rather than left as stale absolution.

reviewed.text: Found the volume instead of the surface area
reviewed.reason: This is a misconception LABEL, not instruction. It names an error a student made — computing volume when the question asked for surface area — and is only ever shown attached to a tagged response on a lesson that teaches both. It teaches nobody a contrast; it describes one student's work.
